evolutions.reason: The attack cycle combines Alchemy Mark, Magical amplification and slow. Team DoT balance changes its passive outcome, so it should be built around the actual equipped roster.
evolutions.unlock: Unlocks the combined Alchemy cycle and team-dependent passive.

evolutions.reason: Colossal Roar combines Dismember with a Physical damage buff in range. Its half-range trigger requires deliberate positioning, rather than placing it at the edge of coverage.
evolutions.unlock: Adds the close-range Colossal Roar.

evolutions.reason: Time Stop creates a window for existing DoT effects. The evolved kill interaction extends that window and stores Flame Feathers, so wave density matters more than sheet DPS.
evolutions.unlock: Time Stop kills extend duration and store Flame Feathers.

evolutions.reason: Enhanced Burn stored by Demon Head is converted into a detonation. This makes DoT scaling valuable, but the explosion depends on its setup window and enemies remaining grouped.
evolutions.unlock: Adds the stored-burn detonation.
